input: Dîba diakabuela muinshi mua diulu, difila butoke bua kapia mu misesu ya mu tshimenga ivua ne bantu ba bungi. Bantu benda lubilu lubilu mu nseke ya njila, makasa abu avua umvuika pa tshibandilu pavua miyuki mienda ivulangana ne mutoyi. Mu ma kafe, mupuya wa kafe mupiamupia uvua musambakane ne mupuya wa bintu bia kuenza nabi mampa, bilomba bantu bavua bapita bua kuimana ne kudia. Bena manaya ba mu misesu bakasakidila misambu ne tshiona, kukudimuna tshimenga mu tshitupa tshîpi tshilengeja tshia mutoyi ne mekala. Pavua dilolo dienda dijika, miendu ya mu tshimenga ivua itema, ikenkesha dinaya dia nsombelu wa mu tshimenga divua kadiyi dijika nansha kakese.

Mu tshitupa tshinene tshia mikuna mitumbuke ne mitshi milenga, lupepele luvua luela malu masokoka mu mabeji. Banyama ba muitu bavua benda banyema muinshi mua tshisasa, ngendu yabu ivua anu bu manaya a mutoyi avua menzeke muinshi mua dîsu dia muulu. Musulu uvua unyunguluka bitekete bitekete mu buloba, pa mutu pawu uvua uleja butoke bua dîba ne wenza bimfuanyi bivua bikenka bivua bisankisha mêsu. Nyunyi ivua yimba misambu ivua imueneka bu ivua ileja muyuki wa bintu bia pa buloba, musambu wa muoyo uvua umvuika mu ditalala. Mu muaba eu wa ditalala, dîba divua dimueneka dienda bitekete bitekete, difila bikondo bia kuela meji ne ditalala bua kukola.

Munda mua nzubu munene wa mikanda, bitanda bivua bitangalake kabiyi ne ndekelu, biuwule tente ne mikanda ya malu onso. Dinunkila dia mabeji a kale ne bipese bia tshiseba diakawuja lupepele, dibikila bakebuludi ba mamanya bua kubuela mu maloba bungi kabuyi kubala. Batangi badi basombe mu bibambalu bilenga ne ku mêsa manene, mêsu abu atangila mabeji pavua lungenyi luabu luenda luenda mu ngenyi, miyuki ne bintu bivuabu bapete. Imue misangu, mutoyi wa dikudimuna dia mabeji uvua ujikija mutoyi wa diteka ntema yonso. Pambelu, buloba buvua butungunuka ne lubilu luabu, kadi munda mua bimanu ebi, tshibuashibuashi tshia meji ne lungenyi bivua bikola mu ditalala diakane.

Mu tshisalu tshivua ne bantu ba bungi, bapanyi bavua bela mbila bua bintu bivuabu bafila, bakeba bua kubateleja munkatshi mua mitoyi mikole. Miaba ivua miule tente ne bimuma bia mupuya muimpe, bintu bia mupuya muimpe, ne bilamba bia mekala, tshintu tshionso tshivua tshileja muyuki wa ntuadijilu ne wa mudimu wa bianza. Basumbishi bavua bakokangana pa mishinga ne bashintakaja miyuki, bienza tshimfuanyi tshilenga tshia malanda a bantu. Dipembu dia nyama mioshe ne dia mampa matoke divua dienda mu lupepele, disaka bantu bavua bapita bua kudia. Munkatshi mua tshimvundu, kuvua tshilele tshia muinshi mua buloba — tshienzedi tshivua tshilama tshisalu tshikale ne muoyo ne tshikole, tshijadiki tshia lungenyi lua buobumue lua kashidi.

Pa mbuu mualabale, mavuala akakuma ku tshilamba tshia buatu, kutumawu mâyi a mukele mu lupepele. Bena mudimu bavua benda ne tshipatshila, balongolola mazuwa ne benda mu tshibuashibuashi tshinene tshia bule, balombodibua anu kudi mitoto ne lungenyi lua meji. Muulu uvua mutangalake kakuyi ndekelu, tshilamba tshia mekala avua ashintuluka kumbukila ku dinda too ne ku dilolo, tshileja bulengele bua buloba budi kabuyi ne mikalu. Nyunyi ya nkutshi ivua inyunguluka pa mutu, dîyi diayi ivua yumvuika pa mayi, ivuija mutoyi wa mbuu. Nansha muvua mbuu muikale nkayende, lungenyi lua diendakana ne lua dipeta diakakola munkatshi mua tshibuashibuashi tshidi katshiyi ne ndekelu.

Munkatshi mua tshipalu tshia mu tshimenga tshivua ne mutoyi, tuseku tua bana tuvua tuenda tuseka pavuabu banaya pa bibandilu ne pa bibandilu. Bena mu mêku bavua benza picnic pa bilamba bivua bitangalake pa bisonsa, bayukila miyuki ne basanka pamue muinshi mua mundidimbi wa mitshi mile. Bena lubilu ne bendeshi ba makalu bavua benda mu njila minyanguke, ngendu yabu ivua yenza tshimfuanyi tshia ditalala dia bufuki munkatshi mua nsombelu wa mu tshimenga. Ntambue ne nyunyi ya nkutshi bivua biendakana bimpe pa mutu pa tshina tshia mâyi, bienza bua muaba au ikale mu ditalala. Pavua dituku dienda dijika, parc wakalua muaba wa ditalala muvua bena mu tshimenga bapeta dikisha ku midimu yabu ya pa tshibidilu.

Nsongo ya mukuna ivua ifila tshimuenenu tshilenga tshia mikuna idi minyunguluke ne mikuna ya kule. Bantu badi babandila mikuna bavua badisangishe pabuipi ne kapia kakese, bamanyishangana miyuki ya luendu luabu ne bilota bia malu avuabu mua kuenza mu matuku atshilualua. Lupepele luvua lutoke ne luvua lukolesha, luwuja mifuba ne oxygène mukezuke uvua ukolesha. Bitupa bia neje bivua bilamate ku mikuna ya mabue, bikenka muinshi mua butoke bua dîba, bishilangane ne buloba bufiike ne bisonsa bikese bivua kuinshi. Pavua matutu enda apita, mindidimbi ivua inyunguluka muaba wonso, ileja bulengele bua muaba au. Kuimana pa mutu pa buloba, muntu udi umvua dipetangana dikole ne bunene bua bufuki budi kabuyi bujika.

Mu tshitupa tshia ku mpenga kua tshimenga, mêku avua enza midimu yawu ne dîyi ditekete. Bana bavua banaya hopscotch mu nseke ya njila, tuseku tuabu tuenda tuenda tuenda mu lupepele pavua baledi batangila ne ntema yonso ku madidishi avua pabuipi apu. Madimi avua ne misombelu ya bungi — bilongo bia rose, tulipe, marguerite — bionso ebi biluishangana bua kupeta butoke bua dîba ne ntema. Dinunkila dia bisonsa bipiabipia ne bilongo bidi bipatuka bivua bienza bua se bantu bikale ne nsombelu muimpe uvua uleja bumuntu bua nzubu. Dilolo diakalua ne butoke butekete bua miendu ya mu njila ne lungenyi lua ditalala ludi misangu ya bungi lupita kayi lumueneka kadi ludi luanyishibua bikole.

Bikulukulu bia kale bivua bilonda miyuki ya bantu bavua bafue kale, bimanu biabu bia mabue bivua binyanguke kadi bivua bishalaku. Mionji ya tumuma tua mvinyo ne mitshi ya moss bivua bienda mu njila, bileja dipita dia matuku ne dipingaja dia bintu bia bufuki kudi bufuki. Bakebuludi bavua batambakana mu bimanu ne mu lupangu, bela meji bua nsombelu uvuaku kumpala mu nzubu eyi. Ditalala divua dikole, dinyanguka anu kudi mutoyi wa makasa ne dibikila dia nyunyi uvua kule. Pavua dîba dibuela panyima pa mabue, bindidimbi bivua bienda bikola, bienza bua muaba au ikale ne luya lua malu adi kaayi umvuika ne lua kanemu. Bivua tshivulukilu tshia dikalaku dia malu a kale ne miyuki ivua mu dibue dionso.

Mu tshipalu tshia ndeke tshivua ne mutoyi, benyi bavua bapita lubilu ne lungenyi lua ditekemena ne dijinga dia bungi. Mashinyi a bintu avua atuta panshi pavua miyuki ya mu miakulu ya bungi miule tente. Biamu bia ku Enternete bivua bileja mêba a dipatuka ne a difika, bilombola bantu bavua kabayi ne lutulu anyi bavua ne disanka bua kuya muaba uvuabu baya. Makopo a kafe ne bipese bia biakudia bia patupu bivua bitangalake mu matumba kampanda, tshijadiki tshia biakudia bia mu dinda bia lukasa ne bia dilongolola dia ku minite ya ndekelu. Munkatshi mua tshimvundu tshilongolola, kuvua ngumvuilu wa muomumue — tshikondo tshia tshitupa tshîpi tshia dipetangana pankatshi pa benyi bavua ne dijinga dia muomumue dia kukebulula, kupingana anyi kukeba ntuadijilu mupiamupia. Luendu luvua anu pabuipi ne kutungunuka.

Pa tshidila tshilenga, mavuala matekete avua afika ku nkula ya nsenga mimpe, avua abikila bantu bua kuikisha ne kuela meji. Mitshi ya nkunde ivua inyunguluka mu lupepele lua mbuu, tshimfuanyi tshiayi tshivua tshishilangane ne diulu dia azure. Bantu bavua baya ku muelelu wa mâyi bavua basomba munya, bibaka nzubu ya nsenga, ne basangisha bikunyibua bia mu mbuu, benza malu mapepele avua aleja mparadizu. Muinshi mua mayi, mikuna ya koray idi ne bintu bia mu mayi bia mekala mashilangane, idi mua kumueneka mu mayi matoke adi aleja buloba busokoka bua dikema. Pavua dilolo dienda disemena, tshibuashibuashi tshiakafika ku dikala dia orange ne dia rose, bileja ndekelu wa dituku dikuabu mu tshibandabanda etshi tshia ditalala. Bulengele bua tshidila etshi buvua bufila muaba wa tshijila kule ne mutoyi wa nsombelu wa ku dituku ne ku dituku.

Mu nzubu wa biro wa matuku etu aa, bena mudimu bavua benza mudimu pamue mu nzubu ya tshisangilu ya bimanu bia makala ne miaba ya mudimu miunzulula. Mutoyi wa ordinatere ne dikubakuba dia telefone bivua bienza mutoyi wa panyima, uvua ushintuluka kudi dikuma dia biamu bia kufunda nabi ne disangisha dia mabeji. Nzubu ya dikisha ivua ifila bikondo bia dikisha, ne bena mudimu nabu bavua banua kafe ne bayukila patupu. Bimanyinu ne biamu bivua bileja tablo, mêba a mudimu, ne ngenyi ivua yenda ishintuluka, bionso ebi bienza mudimu bua kukumbaja bipatshila bia muomumue. Nansha muvuaku mudimu wa bungi, kuvua lungenyi lua tshipatshila ne malu mapiamapia avua aleja dikeba dia matuku etu aa dia kuya kumpala ne diakalengele.

Tshipalu tshia mashinyi tshivua ne mutoyi tshivua tshienza mudimu bu muaba uvua bantu bendakana, muvua miyuki ya bungi ipetangana. Bena mudimu bavua baya lukasa bua kuangata mashinyi abu, bakuate mifuku ne mifuku, tshionso tshikale ne muaba uvuabu baya ne bilota. Basumbishi ba bintu badi bapana bya kudya ne bikandakanda ku luseke lua bitanda bia tike bivua biumvuika ne mêyi ne mamanyisha. Tshibandilu tshiakanyunguluka ne ditekemena pavua motere wela mbila, uleja dipatuka ne difika. Mu tshitupa etshi tshia tshitupa tshîpi, bikondo bia dipetangana ne bia dishiyangana bivua bisambakana, bienza bu mudi nsombelu wa ku dituku ne ku dituku mu buloba buvua kabuyi bulekela kuenda.

Munda mua mpata, butoke bua dîba buvua bupitshila mu tshisuku tshia mabeji, buenza bimfuanyi bia mabala pa buloba butekete buvua kuinshi. Bifukibua bia mishindu yonso bivua biendakana mu muaba uvuabi bisombela, tshionso tshienza mudimu watshi mu njila mikole ya muoyo. Lupepele luvua ne mupuya muimpe wa mitshi ya moss, ya pine ne ya buloba buume, bienza bua muntu umvue ne: uvua mushindame kale. Musulu mutekete uvua unyunguluka mu mitshi, mutoyi wende uvua wenza bu mutoyi wa ditalala wa mu tshipela tshivua katshiyi ne mutoyi. Muaba wa tshijila eu udi kauyi mulengejibue uvua mushale tshijadiki tshia ditantamana dia bufuki ne bulengele bua kashidi bua miaba idi kayiyi milengejibue.

Mu tshikuku muvua mudimu wa bungi pavua bafidi ba biakudia bateka biakudia bia bungi. Mutoyi wa tshisuku udi ufumina mu bisuku udi musambakane ne mupuya wa bikunyibua, wa bintu bia mupuya muimpe, ne wa mampa mapiamapia, bienza muaba muimpe. Bintu bya kudya byadi bikosolola, byasambakanya, ne byalengeja biyampe, kintu kyonso kikwashanga ku buobumue bwa butobaji. Bena mudimu bavua bendakana kakuyi lutatu pankatshi pa nzubu ya mudimu, benza mudimu pamue bua kujadika ne: dilongo dionso divua dikumbane. Benyi bavua bindile biakudia biabu, ditekemena dienda divula pavua bintu bia kudia bilua pamue — tshiakudia tshionso tshivua mudimu wa bianza muenza bua kusankisha lungenyi ne kusankisha anyima.

Mu nzubu wa binjinjimbi, bimanu bivua bilengejibue ne bintu bia mishindu ne mishindu, bimfuanyi ne foto. Benyi bavua benda bitekete bitekete ku tshitupa ne ku tshitupa, yonso wa kudibu wimana bua kumvuija ne kuanyisha bikena kumona bia benji ba binjinjimbi. Butoke buvua buleja bimpe bintu ne malu makese, bienza bua bintu bia dizola bikale ne muoyo. Miyuki mipuekele pa bidi bitangila mishindu ya kuenza mudimu, mushindu udi muntu udiumvua ne diumvuija dia malu bivua bivudije malu avua menzeke. Muaba au uvua muaba wa tshijila wa dienza dia bintu ne dielangana meji, muvua bukole bua dileja dia bintu bivua bimueneka bukolesha lungenyi lupialupia ne lukolesha lungenyi.

Mu dinda menemene ku tshina tshia mâyi, lupuishi luvua lujuka bitekete bitekete pa mutu pa mâyi, luenza luya lukole. Ntambue ivua yenda mu buatu ne budinangi, ishiya mavuala mu nyima yayi, eku nyunyi ya nkutshi ivua ipueka pa mutu pa bisonsa. Ditalala dia mu dinda diakanyanguka anu kudi mutoyi mutekete wa nyunyi ya misambu ivua yakidila dituku. Mitshi ivua minyunguluke ivua imueneka mu mayi matalale, ivua ivuija ditalala misangu ibidi. Tshikondo etshi tshia ditalala tshivua tshileja bulengele bua bufuki kumpala kua buloba kujuka, tshituvuluija mishindu ya ditalala idi mu tshijengu tshia bufuki.

Miendu ya mu nzubu wa manaya yakakepela pavua rido mubandile, kuleja muaba wa manaya uvua kauyi mua kupua muoyo. Bantu badi benza manaya badi babuela mu midimu yabu, baleja bantu ne dinanga ne dishindika, benza bua muyuki wikale ne muoyo. Bateleji bavua basankidila, tuseku ne dikupila dia bianza bivua bileja bikondo bia dibungama ne malu a dikema. Mijiki ne butoke biakakolesha lungenyi ne luya, bikudimuna muaba au muaba wa kuela meji ne wa kukema. Pakajika tshibilu, bantu bakatuadija kuela bianza, basanka bua mudimu ne mudimu uvua muenze bua tshibilu etshi tshikale bualu budi kabuyi mua kupua muoyo kudi bantu bonso.

Mu misoko ya pa mpenga, nzubu ivua mu milongo milongolola bimpe, nzubu yonso ne budimi buende buwule tente ne bilongo ne bisonsa. Mu misesu muvua mpala ya bantu bamanyike ne mitu ya bulunda, bileja lungenyi lua buobumue ne dishindama. Bana bavua banaya mu lupangu pavua bantu bakole benza midimu ya kumbelu anyi bayukila pa bibandilu. Mutoyi wa bupole wa mu nsombelu wa ku dituku ne ku dituku uvua muenza bua kuikala ne nsombelu muimpe, uleja mushinga wa nzubu ne malanda. Pavua dilolo dienda difika, butoke butekete bua miendu ya ku tshisasa buakaakidila butuku, buakafika mu nsombelu wa ditalala wa mu tshimenga.

Njila wa ku mikuna uvua unyunguluka muulu mu miaba mikole, uvua ukolesha benda-mikuna ne mikuna mitumbuke ne mabue. Dikasa dionso divua dilomba didienzeja ne dipangadika, difutu dia bintu bilenga bia kumona ku mutu kua tshibandabanda. Lupepele lua mashika lua ku mikuna luvua lukolesha lungenyi, eku bilongo bia muitu ne mitshi mikole bivua bilamata ku miaba ya mabue. Imue misangu, muadi wa nyunyi wa mukanku uvua kule anyi dimona dia mbuji wa ku mikuna bivua bivuluija bantu bavua bendakana bintu bia muitu bivua bibanyunguluke. Kufika ku tshibandabanda kuvua tshikondo tshia ditshimuna, tshijadiki tshia dinanukila ne bukole bua dikema bua bufuki.

Tshisalu tshia mu tshimenga tshia kale tshivua ne mudimu wa bungi, ne bangenda-mushinga bavua bela mbila bua kusumba bintu ne bantu bavua basumba bintu ne disanka dionso. Bibambalu bivua biuwule tente ne bintu bia bianza, bintu bia mupuya muimpe ne bilamba, tshintu tshionso tshivua tshileja tshitupa tshia bumpianyi bua bilele bia mu tshimenga. Dipembu dia biakudia bia pa buabi diakawuja lupepele, disaka bantu bavua bapita bua kudia bipese bipiabipia. Mitoyi ya misambu ne ya maja ya benji ba manaya bavua pabuipi apu ivua mivudije nsombelu muimpe. Tshitudilu etshi tshivua ne bantu ba bungi katshivua anu muaba wa kusumbishila bintu to; uvua njila wa ntanta wa malu a kale, bilele, ne malanda a bantu.

Muinshi mua diulu dia butuku, kapia kavua katema kafila mundidimbi wa maja pa mpala ya bendakanyi bavua batshioke. Pavuabu bayukila miyuki ne bimba misambu, bavua basanka mu disanka dipepele dia bulunda. Mudilu uvua utema uvua ufila luya lua mashika, eku mitoto ya muulu ivua ifila tshilamba tshia mu diulu tshia dikema tshidi katshiyi ne ndekelu. Dibikila dia tshisuku dia kule ne dikuma dia mabeji diakalengeja muaba muimpe. Mu tshikondo etshi, munyunguluka kudi bufuki ne balunda, tshikondo tshivua tshimueneka tshiimane, tshileja dinanga dia kashidi dia ngendu ya pambelu.

Tshisangilu tshia balongi tshiakasangisha bamanyi ba pa buloba bujima bua kuabanyangana ngenyi ne kuakula bua malu mapiamapia. Bangamba-malu banene bakenza miyuki mikole, ne kutuadijabu mishindu mipiamipia ya dikonka ne dienza mudimu pamue. Bikondo bia dikokangana bivua bikolesha diyukidilangana, bikolesha tshisumbu tshia bantu badi ne lungenyi lua kujinga kumanya malu. Dishintakaja dia mamanya diakakumbajibua kudi malu a dipetangana ne midimu ya bilele, bivua bivudija dimanya dia malu kupita tulasa tua bikadilu. Pavua tshisangilu etshi tshijika, bantu bavua babuelamu bakafila ngenyi mipiamipia ne malanda avua mua kuenzeka, bivua bikolesha dienda dia kumpala mu midimu yabu.

Mvula mutekete wakaloka mu tshimenga, kuenzaye tshiona tshia madidishi ne pa mutu pa nzubu. Bantu bavua benda pa makasa bavua benda lubilu muinshi mua mitoto, makasa abu avua enda lubilu kadi kaayi ne lukasa, bualu bintu bivua bimueneka pa njila uvua ne mâyi. Dinunkila dia buloba buume ne mvula muimpe bivua bikolesha lungenyi, bifila tshikondo tshia dilengejibua mu nsombelu wa mu tshimenga. Miendu ya mu njila idi ikenka bu or, mishilangane ne diulu dia mashika dia nsukadi, idi ifila luya luimpe ku tshikena kumona. Disulakana ne bupole biakapingana pa muaba wa tshimvundu tshia kumpala, pavua tshimenga tshiakidila mvula, tshivuluija muntu yonso bukole bua bupole bua bufuki.

Ntempelo wa kale uvua tshijadiki tshia mudimu wa bianza wa bantu ne wa malu a mu nyuma, bimanu biende bia mabue bivua binyanguke kudi lupepele ne mvula bidimu nkama ne nkama. Bimfuanyi bisonga ne mpingu bivua bilengeja mpala wende, bifunda miyuki ya ditabuja ne ya nkindi. Bena luendu ne benyi bavua bapeta busambi ne dikankamija mu miaba yende ya ditalala, muvua ditalala ne kanemu biuwule tente ne lupepele. Dikalaku dia ntempelo divua dilamakaja malu a kale ne a mpindieu, dienza bu tshivulukilu tshia tshijila tshia bumpianyi bua bilele ne dikeba dia kashidi dia diumvuija. Bu muvua butoke bua dîba buenda bupita mu miaba mipanduluke ne mu miaba mipatuke, lungenyi lua kaluyi ne tshikondo luakabuikila muaba au.

Tshibilu tshia disanka tshivua tshienzedi tshia mekala, mutoyi ne disanka. Mashinyi avua anyunguluka ne abanda, maule tente ne mbila ya disanka, eku nzubu ya manaya ivua ifila mishindu ya kupeta bintu ne tuseku. Bena manaya bavuale bilamba bavua basankisha bantu ne manaya a ndundu, malu a majimbu, ne manaya a mijiki, bivua bikuata lungenyi lua bantu ba bidimu bionso. Dinunkila dia bonbon wa ntole, dia popcorn, ne dia sosise mioshe diakasaka bantu bavua babuelamu bua kudisankisha. Pavua butuku buenda bufika, miendu ivua ikenka ne mijiki bivua bienza bua se bantu bikale ne disanka, tshisumbu tshia bantu ne masanka mapepele a mu nsombelu.

Mu ditumba dia nzubu wa mikanda didi ditalala, mesa umue uvua mutokeshibue kudi muendu, ubikila mubadi bua kudijimija mu mukanda. Mabeji avua ne bintu bia dikema, dimanya, ne lungenyi, tshionso tshivua tshiibi tshia ngumvuilu mupiamupia anyi tshia kunyema. Ditalala dia muaba au diakakolesha lungenyi ne dielangana meji, muaba wa tshijila ku tshimvundu tshia pambelu. Pabuipi apu, bitanda bilongolola bilondeshile tshiena bualu ne mufundi bivua bifila bintu bia bungi bia meji a bantu ne bipedi biabu. Muaba eu wa dijinga dia kumanya malu udi uleja bukole budi nabu dibala bua kufila lungenyi, kulongesha ne kushintulula malu.

Budimi bua tumuma tua mvinyo buvua butangalake pa mikuna mitumbuke, mionji ya tumuma tua mvinyo ivua miule tente ne tumuma tua mvinyo tuakadi tulongolola bua kunowa. Bena mudimu bavua benda mu bulongame pankatshi pa milongo, bakosa ne bakosa, yonso wa kudibu utangila buloba ne budimu ne dimanya. Dîba diakafila dikala dia or pa buloba buimpe, dilengeja matamba a matamba ne a violet mikole. Lupepele luvua luule tente ne dipembu dimpe dia bimuma ne buloba, bileja tshidi nsombelu wa madimi. Pavua tshikondo tshia dinowa tshienda tshisemena, ditekemena diakavula bua mvinyo ivuabu ne bua kuenza ku tusumbu tua mvinyo tua mushinga mukole etu.

Musoko uvua mubuikila kudi neje uvua muaba muimpe wa kumona mu muvu wa mashika, ne nzubu ivua mibuikila ne mabue matoke ne mabue a mashika avua malengeja ku bimanu. Njila ivua mipuwe, mibuikila kudi dikuluka ditekete dia neje, bienza ditalala dia ditalala. Bana bakenza bantu ba mu neje ne bavua baluangana ne mabue a neje, tuseku tuabu tuenda tuenda tuenda mu lupepele lukole. Miendu ya kapia ya mu nzubu ya tshilala benyi ne ya mu makazen ivua mishilangane bimpe ne mashika avua pabuipi apu, ivua ifila disanka dia bungi. Muaba wonso uvua umueneka bu uvua ukenka ne malu a dikema a mu tshikondo atshi, uvua ubikila bantu bonso bua kuakidila ditalala dia mu muvu wa mashika.

Mu tshimenga tshia ku tshitudilu tshia mazuwa tshivua ne mutoyi, mazuwa a bintu ne a kuloba nawu mishipa avua apueka mu tshitudilu, mitshi yawu mitangile muulu. Bena mudimu ba ku tshitudilu tshia mazuwa bavua benda lubilu, bambula ne bapuekesha bintu bivua bikolesha bubanji bua tshimenga ne bivua bitshilamakaja ne buloba bujima. Mashinyi a mu tshisalu avua ku muelelu kua tshitudilu tshia mazuwa avua afila bintu bipiabipia bivuabu bakuate, bintu bia bianza, ne bintu bia kuvuluka nabi bua benyi ne bena muaba au. Dinunkila dia mayi a mukele, dia bintu bia mu mayi, ne dia mazutu adi asambakana mu lupepele, adi aleja bukole bua bintu bidi mu mbuu. Pavua mazuwa enda anyi afika, tshimenga tshivua tshienda tshikola bua diendakana, ngendu ne dikokangana dia kashidi dia mbuu.

Dimanya dia kuenza mampa diakawuja nzubu wa mampa ne mupuya muimpe uvua usaka bantu bavua bapita bua kubuela munda. Mampa ne mampa avua mafuma ku dienza bivua bilongolola bimpe mu bibombi, bipese bia or ne bitupa biawu bivua bilenga lungenyi. Bafumbi ba mampa bavua bela mbila pavuabu bapela bukula ne benza mampa, dimanya diabu divua dimueneka mu bualu buonso. Bantu badi basumba bintu badi basanka ne muaba muimpe, badia bintu bia kudia ne kafe anyi tshiayi, bayukila pa bidia bia mu mampa. Mudimu wa dilamba eu kauvua anu udisha to, kadi uvua kabidi ulamakaja bantu ku diambuluisha dia bilele, dienza dia bintu ne disanka dipepele dia biakudia bimpe.

Munkatshi mua mudimu uvua ne mudimu wa bungi, bena mudimu bavua benza mudimu ne tshisumi mu midimu yabu, tshintu tshionso tshivua tshileja dimanya diabu ne dinanga diabu. Bintu byadi bya ku mitshi ne bya tshiamu too ne ku bilamba ne dilongo, ne benji ba mudimu bavua bakudimuna bintu bia tshianana mu bintu bia mudimu. Mutoyi wa tshiamu tshia mitaku, wa marto, ne wa tshiamu tshia kukosa natshi bintu uvua musambakane mu tshiona tshia bufuki. Benyi bavua banyisha mudimu wa bianza, misangu ya bungi bavua babasaka bua kuenza midimu yabu ya dizola. Mudimu eu uvua tshijadiki tshia meji a bantu ne dikokangana dia kashidi dia bintu bienza ne bianza ne bia mushinga.

Mu tshikondo tshia tshibilu tshia dikema, bintu bia pa mâyi bivua bilengeja ne bilongo ne miendu bivua bienda mu misesu, bisekelela bumpianyi bua bilele ne lungenyi lua bena mutumba. Bena manaya bavuale bilamba bavua baja ne bimba misambu, basankisha bantu ba bidimu bionso. Miaba ya kudiila ivua ifila biakudia bia kale, bifila butobaji bua bipungu bia kale. Lupepele luvua luwule tente ne disanka, tuseku, ne disanka dia tshisumbu dia kuenza mudimu. Pavua butuku buenda bufika, bintu bia kapia bivua bikenkesha diulu, bileja ndekelu wa tshibilu tshimpe tshivua tshisangisha bantu pamue bua kusekelela.

Miaba ya pa mpenga ivua mienza ne madimi ne mitshi, muvua dîba dimueneka bu dienda dienda bitekete bitekete. Babidime bavua balama madimi ne bimuna, bilele biabu bivua bifumine ku bilele bia bidimu bia bungi. Misoko mikese ivua munkatshi mua bisonsa, ne nzubu ya tshilala benyi ivua ileja bulenga bua mu mpata. Mitoyi mitekete ya bufuki — nyunyi idi yimba, lupepele luenda lupita mu mabeji, mutoyi wa ngombe wa kule — biakafuka mutoyi muimpe. Muaba muimpe eu uvua ufila mushindu wa kuikishila ku nsombelu wa mu tshimenga, uvua uvuluija benyi ditalala ne bupepele bidi mu bufuki.

Mu lupitadi lua matuku etu aa, bena mudimu ba malu a bukola bua mubidi bavua benza mudimu mukole bua kutabalela babedi, didifila diabu divua dimueneka mu tshienzedi tshionso. Muaba uvua kauyi ne disama uvua muaba wa midimu, ne baminganga ne baminganga bavua balombola ngondapilu ne batangila bimanyinu bia mushinga mukole. Biamu bia mudimu bia kumpala biakambuluisha bua kumanya disama ne diondopangana, bileja dipetangana dia luse ne dienza dia malu mapiamapia. Babedi bapeta busambi mu dimanya ne bulenga bua bena mudimu, beyemena tshipatshila tshiabu tshia kupingaja makanda a mubidi ne nsombelu muimpe. Muaba eu uvua tshijadiki tshia dinanukila dia bantu ne dikeba dia diondapangana.

Tshipela tshivua tshitangalake kakuyi ndekelu, tshitupa tshinene tshia nsenga ne miaba ya mabue muinshi mua dîba dikole. Mitshi ya cactus ne mitshi mikole ivua milamate ku muoyo mu muaba eu mukole, dinanukila diayi divua dikemesha. Bena ngendu bavua benda muaba au ne budimu, bamanye njiwu ne bulengele bua mu tshipela etshi. Bimfuanyi bia dikema bivua bikenka mu bule, bintu bia dishima bivua bienza malu a bundu ku mêsu kadi bivua bivudija tshishima tshia muaba au. Dibuela dia dîba diakashintulula tshipela tshilue tshilamba tshia kapia tshikunze ne tshia orange, tshimuenenu tshia tshitupa tshîpi tshia bukole bua bufuki ne bulengele bua dikema.

Nzubu muimpe uvua munkatshi mua mitshi mile uvua ufila muaba wa tshijila kudi bantu ba pambelu. Miaba ya kapia ivua itema, ifila butoke bua kapia buvua bukumbaja dilengeja dia nzubu. Benyi bavua basomba ne mikanda anyi bayukila miyuki, basanka ne ditalala dia muaba uvuabu basombele. Pambelu, neje ivua iloka bitekete bitekete, mibuikila buloba ne butoke, kadi munda, luya ne busambi bivua bikokesha. Muaba eu wa pa muoyo uvua uleja dipingana mu malu mapepele ne busambi budibu bapeta mu dikuatshisha dia bufuki, muaba muimpe wa kunyemena bua kuikisha ne kupeta bukole.

Mu nzubu wa manaya wa mu tshimenga, benji ba manaya bavua badilongolole kunyima kua tshipalu, buôwa ne disanka diabu bivua bimueneka patoke. Tshisumbu tshia bimbi ba misambu tshiakalongolola biamu biabu bia kuimba nabi misambu pavua bantu batua bianza ne bakula bikole mu nzubu wa tshisangilu. Pavua rido mubande, tshipalu tshiakashintuluka tshilua buloba bua manaya, tuseku anyi malu a kanyinganyinga, bikuata bateleji ne bibasaka bua kuandamuna ku muoyo. Buobumue bua dienza dia manaya — benji ba manaya, bimbi ba misambu, bena mudimu ba ku tshipalu — bakafuka tshintu tshilenga tshia tshitupa tshîpi tshivua anu mu tshikondo atshi. Pavua tshikena kumona tshia ndekelu tshijika ne bantu bavua batua bianza, tshishima tshia manaya tshiakavuluija muntu yonso bukole budi nabu miyuki ne mushindu udi muntu uleja malu.

Lupango lua nzubu wa tshitendelelu lua ditalala luvua muaba wa dielangana meji ne wa ditalala. Ba-monk bavua bendakana mu nzubu ya tshitendelelu, balama madimi ne balongolola masambila a ku dituku ne ku dituku. Dinunkila dia musenga wa manananshi ne bilongo bia bilongo bivua bivudije nsombelu wa mu nyuma, bivua bikolesha lungenyi ne ditalala. Benyi anyi bena musoko bavua bapeta busambi mu bupepele ne mu dinyoka dia nsombelu wa bena monastère, muvua dielangana meji ne bena mu tshisumbu bipetangana. Bu mudibu bashindamene pa bilele bia kale, muaba eu wa tshijila uvua muaba wa tshijila wa anyima munkatshi mua tshimvundu tshia pambelu.

Muaba uvua bantu ba bungi benza mudimu wa luibaku, bena mudimu bavua benza mudimu pamue bua kuibaka nzubu mupiamupia, muntu ne muntu uvua ufila dimanya diende. Mutoyi wa tshiamu ne mutoyi wa mashinyi bivua bileja dienda dia kumpala, eku mikenji ya bukubi ilama muntu yonso mu bukubi. Bintu biakafika mu mushindu udi kauyi ushintuluka — beton, mitshi ya tshiamu, mabue a mabue — tshitupa tshionso tshivua ne mushinga wa bungi bua mudimu eu wikale muimpe. Bafundi ba nzubu ne ba-enjenyere bavua balombola mudimu eu, bajadike ne: mushindu uvuabu balongolole uvua muenzeke bimpe menemene. Muaba au uvua tshijadiki tshia dijinga dia bantu ne mudimu wa buobumue uvua ukengela bua kukumbaja malu avuabu balongolole.

Dibue dia mabue a koray divua diuwule tente ne muoyo muinshi mua mâyi matoke a mbuu. Bisumbu bia mishipa ya mekala a bungi bivua biendakana munkatshi mua matamba a mabue a koray, eku mbua ya mu mbuu milenga ipita. Bifukibua bia mu tshibandabanda bivua ne bintu bia bungi bivua bikuatshisha mishindu ya bungi ya nyama, yonso wa kudiyi uvua ne mudimu munene wa kulama bulongame. Bantu badi benda mu mâyi ne badi benda mu mâyi bakaya mu mparadizu wa muinshi mua mâyi eu, bakema bua bulengele ne mishindu yende. Kulama miaba eyi idi kayiyi ne bukole kuvua ne mushinga wa bungi bua kulama bubanji bua bintu bidi mu mâyi bua bipungu bidi bilua.

Mu ntempelo wa bena Buddha uvua ne ditalala, ba-monk bavua benza malu a mikiya ne belangana meji, bienza bua bantu bikale ne ditalala ne lungenyi lua mu nyuma. Dinunkila dia musenga wa manananshi divua dienda dibuela mu lupepele pavua misambu ivua yumvuika bitekete bitekete, ilombola bena mudimu munda. Bimfuanyi ne bimfuanyi bia nzambi bivua bifila miaba ya kusambila ne kuelangana meji, bivua bikolesha lungenyi lua malanda ne kanemu. Benyi bavua bakeba ditalala ne lungenyi bavua bapeta busambi mu ditalala dia kashidi dia ntempelo. Miaba ya tshijila ya nunku ivua bu miaba ya tshisokomenu ya dikebulula dia munda ne dikolesha dia luse.

Muaba wa dinaya dia ski uvua muwule tente ne malu a bungi pavua bena ski ne bena snowboard benda mu njila ya neje ne ya mikuna. Nkuasa ya kubandisha ivua imbula benyi too ne ku mikuna, ivua ifila tshimuenekelu tshimpe tshia buloba buvua ne neje. Kunyima kua dituku dijima dia ngendu, benyi bakadisangisha mu nzubu ya tshilala benyi mimpe, bayukila miyuki ne badiosha ku kapia kavua katema. Dinunkila dia shokola wa kapia ne biakudia bia mushinga mukole biakawuja lupepele, kukolesha tshipungu tshia disanka tshivua tshilonda. Tshipalu tshia manaya tshia mu muvu wa mashika etshi tshivua tshibilu tshia adrenaline, bufuki, ne bulunda, bienza bua kuvuluka malu avua mashale mutantshi mule panyima pa neje mimane kujika.

Munda mua nzubu wa mudimu mukola, bena sianse bavua benza mateta ne ntema yonso, beyemena bujalame ne dimanya dia mudimu. Biamu bia mudimu bivua bikenka muinshi mua miendu mikole pavuabu bakonkonona bimue bintu ne bafunda malu, bakeba lungenyi lua malu a pa buloba anyi a malu a tekinoloji. Dienza mudimu pamue ne dijinga dia kumanya malu ke bivua bilombola mudimu wabu, misangu ya bungi bivua bifikisha ku malu avua mua kuambuluisha bantu bimpe. Muaba uvua tshisambakaja tshia bulongame ne dikebulula didi kadiyi ne mikalu, dileja lungenyi lua muntu lua dipeta ne dienza dia malu mapiamapia. Tshipeta tshionso tshiakambuluisha bua kukeba ngumvuilu ne kuya kumpala.

Tshisalu tshia mikanda tshimpe tshia mu Main Street tshivua tshisankisha bantu bavua banange mikanda ne tshimuenekelu tshiatshi tshilenga ne bitanda bivua biuwule tente ne mikanda. Batangi badi batangila mikanda milongolola bimpe, bapeta bafundi bapiabapia ne mikanda ya kale idi kayiyi ne tshikondo. Dinunkila dia mabeji a kale divua dibuikila benyi, divudija disanka dia kulenga dia kupeta miyuki ne mamanya. Bena mudimu badi ne bulunda bakafila ngenyi, kusakidila tshintu tshia muntu nkayende ku malu avua menzeke. Muaba eu wa mikanda uvua mukoleshe buobumue, lungenyi ne dilonga, uvua mukoleshe malanda adi pankatshi pa miaku ne bantu badi bayinanga.

Mu budimi bunene bua mitshi, mitshi mimpe ya pa buloba bujima ivua miteka mu bitupa bilongolola bimpa. Njila ivua inyunguluka mu madimi a bilongo mimpe, mu maziba avua kaayi ne mutoyi, ne mu madimi a mitshi avua ne mundidimbi, bivua bibikila bantu bua kuya kumona malu ne kuikala ne ditalala. Bena madimi bavua batabalela mutshi wonso ne dinanga dionso, balama mishindu ya mitshi idi kayiyi mitamba kumueneka ne bulengele bua muaba au. Benyi bavua bakema bua mishindu ya mitshi, balonga malanda adi pankatshi pa bintu ne mishindu ya madimi. Budimi ebu buvua muaba wa tshijila wa bamanyi ne bapiabapia, tshimfuanyi tshia bintu bia dikema bia bufuki ne meji a bantu.

Muaba wa manaya uvua ne disanka ne mashika ne mashinyi ende a njila, nkata ya Ferris ne manaya. Miendu mikole ne mijiki ya disanka bivua bienza bua bantu bikale ne makanda avua akoka bantu bavua bafumina pabuipi ne ba kule. Bana ne bakulumpe badi bapeta bikondo bia disanka ne disanka, bavuluka malu munkatshi mua masanka ne malu a patupu. Miaba ya dipanyishila bintu ivua ifila bintu bionso kubangila ku bonbon wa butoyi too ne ku biakudia bia mupuya muimpe, bienza bua tuetu kutungunuka ne kuenza ngendu. Tshienzedi etshi tshia dijikija lutetuku ne tuseku tshivua tshileja bupepele ne disanka dia dikisha dia tshianana, tshivuluija muntu yonso disanka didi difumina ku malu adibu bapeta pamue.

Mu nzubu wa tshilala benyi wa mu mpata, benyi bavua bapeta dikisha dia ditalala dia mu nsombelu wa ku dituku ne ku dituku. Bintu bia mu nzubu bia mu mpata ne butoke bua kapia bivua bienza muaba muimpe, eku biakudia bia mushinga mukole bivua bifila busambi ne makanda a mubidi. Buloba buvua bunyunguluke buvua ne madimi ne mitshi mipuwe, mimpe bua kuendakana ne kuelangana meji. Mushindu uvua muena nzubu wa tshilala benyi muakidila benyi uvua usaka bantu bua kudimona bu ba muaba wabu ne kuikisha, bienza bua benyi badiumvue bu badi kumbelu. Muaba eu wa bupepele ne wa bufuki uvua mufila dikisha dia bukole, uvua upingaja bendakana ne lubilu lua bitekete, lua budisuile lua nsombelu wa mu misoko.

Nzubu wa bintu bia kale muimpe ne wa matuku etu aa uvua ne bintu bia bungi bia dizola, bia kale ne bia malu a sianse. Benyi bavua benda mu bintu bivuabu balongolole bimpe, benda babuela mu bintu bivua bienza mudimu ne bimfuanyi bivua bifila ngumu. Mudimu wa nzubu uvua mudimu wa bianza, uvua ne mishindu mipiamipia ya kuenza bua kukumbaja bintu bivuabu baleje munda. Programe ya tulasa ne malu a pa buawu bivua bikolesha dijinga dia kumanya malu ne dilonga. Nzubu wa bintu bia kale uvua bu tshibumba tshivua tshilamakaja malu a kale, a mpindieu ne a matuku atshilualua, tshisaka benyi bua kuanyisha lungenyi lua bantu ne lungenyi luabu mu mishindu yonso.

Pa mutu pa mukuna uvua kayi ne mutoyi, nzubu wa tshitendelelu mukese uvua utangila bintu bivua bimunyunguluke, tshibumba tshiende tshivua tshifika muulu. Bena ngendu ne benyi bavua balua bua kupeta busambi, kusambila anyi anu kumona bintu bilenga. Bimanu bia mabue ne bintu bia munda bipepele bivua bileja budipuekeshi ne kanemu, bivua bikolesha bikondo bia kuelangana meji ne bia malanda. Muaba au uvua utuvuluija dikeba dia lukunukunu dia bantu dia kudiunda mu nyuma ne kumvua malu. Pavua dîba dibuela, nzubu wa tshitendelelu uvua umueneka bu muendu wa ditekemena ne ditalala munkatshi mua bintu bia bungi bia mu bufuki.
